notes.title: SCHiM EP release!
notes.notes:
The awesome team of Moonsailor does the audio for SCHiM!

We are delighted to share the first 5 music tracks. 
You can listen to them here on bandcamp.

Hitch a ride on these joyful tunes with us and have the first glimpse of the musical world we built for this adventure.

https://moonsailor.bandcamp.com/album/schim-ep
